model_annotation: Figure 4 presents the distribution of samples across varying values of sample-level ambiguity standard deviation and sample-level maximum ambiguity. The “Malicious” pie chart has two slices: “Annotated” at approximately 0.2% and light blue, and “Unannotated” at about 99.8% and dark blue. Finally, the “Benign” pie chart also has two slices, “Annotated” taking up roughly 2.3% and light blue, and “Unannotated” represents approximately 97.7% and is dark blue.
